$comment: Corrections to what the map has published, newest first. Shown at the foot of the method page (site/metode/). Add an entry when something was wrong: the date it was corrected, the crisis, what was wrong and what was done.

wrong.en: The Norwegian summary for DR Congo said that forces linked to Erik Prince carried out an ambush, and the English said a named American had been "killed or injured". According to Reuters, the Prince-linked contractors were the ones attacked, and Tim Kennedy was wounded, not killed.
wrong.nb: Det norske sammendraget for DR Kongo sa at styrker knyttet til Erik Prince utførte et bakholdsangrep, og det engelske sa at en navngitt amerikaner var «drept eller såret». Ifølge Reuters var det de Prince-tilknyttede kontraktørene som ble angrepet, og Tim Kennedy ble såret, ikke drept.

fixed.en: The summary was withdrawn and rewritten. The Norwegian is now translated from the approved English in a separate step that may not change who did what; every name must appear in the sources; a named person must be stated as killed or wounded, or left out.
fixed.nb: Sammendraget ble trukket og skrevet på nytt. Den norske teksten oversettes nå fra den godkjente engelske i et eget steg som ikke kan endre hvem som gjorde hva; hvert navn må stå i kildene; en navngitt person skal oppgis som drept eller såret, eller utelates.
